about: What the scenario suite runs each incoming message of replies.json on top of, plus first-contact cases (comms/scenarios.py, 2026-10-16). The agency works the AI niche, so every creator is a real AI channel from data/database/gratovo.db (numbers and recent titles are read from it at build time) and every brand a real company seen sponsoring a video there ('seen_on'), described in one plain line. Brand contact names are made up. Earlier messages and deal facts are test fixtures written by hand, never mailbox data; {placeholders} in them are filled from the database. Nothing here is sent to anyone.

agency.name: Gratovo
agency.what_we_do: A small influencer-marketing agency in the AI niche: we find brand sponsorships for YouTube creators who cover AI tools, AI news and coding with AI, and match brands with creators whose audience fits. The brand pays us; we pay the creator.
true_claims: We are a small influencer-marketing agency focused on AI creators.
We connect brands with YouTube creators whose audience fits them.
The creator pays us nothing; our fee comes out of the brand's budget.
